question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
**The correct answer is option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Eficient'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Efficient'.**
 
• The word '**Efficient**' is an **adjective** which means 'achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense'. **(कुशल)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• The new system is highly **efficient** and saves us a lot of time.
 
 
 
• **Therefore, the correct answer would be 'Eficient'.**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Contribution -** a gift or payment to a common fund or collection **(योगदान)**
 
• **Miscalculation - **an error or mistake in calculation **(गणना में त्रुटि)**
 
• **Mediation - **intervention in a dispute in order to resolve it **(मध्यस्थता)**
